observations: Guard007 local listen(16,128) succeeds; the /tmp/nvidia-mps/control connect remains denied with EPERM.
torch.cuda.init() succeeds: CUDA error 304 is resolved by the guard007 listen exception.
Importing moge.model.v3 pulls in flex_gemm, whose Triton autotuner decorators initialize the Triton CUDA driver at import time.

Triton 3.2 CudaUtils compiles its cuda_utils helper (ldconfig -p, then gcc) on a cache miss; the worker audit hook denies subprocess.Popen, so the first strict CPU load fails before any weights are read.
causality: Directly observed in the worker traceback: PermissionError from the reviewed no-child-process audit guard at triton/backends/nvidia/driver.py libcuda_dirs during flex_gemm import.
remaining: Fix proposal: pre-build the Triton cuda_utils helper into a hash-bound run-owned cache in a separate CPU step and point the qualification worker at it, keeping the worker subprocess-free. Requires a distinct qualification005 under the user standing approval of 2026-10-05.
